caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a curved backrest and slender, outward-curving legs. The backrest features an open, violin-shaped splat and extends smoothly downward to form the rear legs. The seat is upholstered in a dark, possibly black fabric with a subtle pattern. The wooden frame of the chair is rendered in shades of brown with visible wood grain. The drawing is set on a beige background and enclosed within a double-lined rectangular border. There is a small signature in the bottom right corner within the border. The composition centers the chair, with no other objects or background features depicted.
title: Side Chair
